records.name: FaveNest

records.name: Dina 4.5

records.name: Vitals 
records.tagline: A Mac activity monitor that thinks in apps, not processes

It keeps 30 days of history, alerts you when an app misbehaves, finds forgotten dev servers, and shows temperatures, fans and battery. Every readout can sit in your menu bar, arranged your way. Pay once. No subscription, no account.

records.name: District Seal

records.description: BitCache is a private place to save, organize and find links, text, images and PDFs across iPhone, iPad and Mac. Capture things from anywhere, organize them when you want, and keep your library in sync through your own iCloud account.

records.name: Sorry, Not Invited
records.tagline: Rank your wedding guest list without the fights
records.description: Not everyone can come. That's okay. You and your partner each rate every guest in private, and the algorithm draws the line at your venue's capacity, so the hard calls never come down to one of you. - Import from The Knot, Zola or any spreadsheet - Several ratings per guest, weighted by what matters to you two - Plus-ones and kids count as seats; couples make or miss the cut together - Free to rate, $9.99 once to reveal who made the cut

records.name: ABTalks
records.tagline: Build real skills. Show your work. Get discovered.
records.description: Build your coding habit. Get discovered. ABTalksOnAI helps people turn learning into proof of work. Join coding challenges, mentored cohorts, and hackathons; build projects; and develop a consistent habit of shipping. Companies can share the skills they need and discover candidates through evaluated work, with personal profiles shared only after the candidate consents.

records.name: Image Color Palette Generator
records.tagline: Extract colors from any image privately on your browser.
records.description: The Colorsinspo Image Color Palette Generator turns any photo or screenshot into a practical, reusable color palette. Instead of guessing, it analyzes pixels to give you precise HEX, RGB, or HSL values. It combines three tools in one: a dominant color extractor, an exact color picker, and a palette editor. Perfect for studying visual balance, building website colors from a hero image, or preparing design tokens for development.

records.name: Next Berth
records.tagline: Find vacant seats before you board.
records.description: Next Berth finds vacant berths from Indian Railways live reservation charts (Full, Partial, Combo) — a seat vacancy tracker other train apps do not offer. Also live train running status, coach seat layouts, and PNR. Free on Google Play. No ads. No signup. Not ticket booking.

records.name: CaptiVision
records.tagline: See who is speaking. Not just what was said.
records.description: Captions provide the spoken words, but in a crowded room, it is crucial to identify the speaker. CaptiVision (www.captivision.app) is an accessibility app that helps hard-of-hearing professionals follow group conversations by combining live, speaker-labeled captions with active speaker tracking and multi-camera video feeds. CaptiVision provides a unified visual stream that eliminates split focus for Deaf and Hard of Hearing individuals in classrooms and meeting spaces.

records.name: Nepenthe Play
records.tagline: The home of playable intelligence.
records.description: Nepenthe Play is a browser-based platform for AI roleplay, interactive stories and games. Each character has an in-world phone with messages, notes and photo albums that update alongside the conversation. The story collection offers AI text adventures in mystery, fantasy, romance and other genres. Players steer authored scenarios in their own words, with story-specific routes and endings. The platform supports English and Simplified Chinese and runs without a download.

records.name: ATS ResumeSprint
records.tagline: Pay once. Tailor your resume. Walk away done.
records.description: ATS ResumeSprint is a pay-once resume tool from KindCraft Digital. Paste a job posting and your resume. It scores how an ATS is likely to read the match, flags missing keywords, and helps rewrite bullets from experience you already have — no invented credentials. Export a single-column Word file. Paid passes keep versions in an encrypted vault. No subscription, ads, or data selling. No public-AI training on your documents. One-time email preview. Help for the job hunt, not a promised interview.

records.name: ShopLoom
records.tagline: Bulk-list your Etsy shop from one spreadsheet. Pay once.
records.description: ShopLoom is a Mac & Windows app for Etsy sellers. Fill in one spreadsheet, point it at a folder of photos, and it creates your Etsy listings in bulk: titles, tags, prices, photos, digital files and video. It checks every row against Etsy's rules first, saves everything as drafts, and edits tags, prices and sections across hundreds of listings at once. It runs on your own computer, and you pay once instead of monthly.

records.name: InImageCompressor
records.tagline: Compress images privately, instantly, right in your browser
records.description: Free online image compressor to compress JPG, PNG, WebP & AVIF images. Reduce image file size instantly in your browser. No upload, no signup — 100% private.

records.name: Nook
records.tagline: A quiet Mac browser that shows the article, not the clutter
records.description: You open a page to read one article and get a cookie banner, a video that starts on its own, and a prompt to sign in. Nook shows the article. Ads and trackers are blocked from the first page you open, reader mode keeps the text and pictures, and focus mode hides the tabs and toolbar. Cookies and cache are cleared when you quit. No account, no sync, no telemetry. macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel. Free.

records.name: ZeroConvert
records.tagline: 100% client-side file converter with zero cloud uploads
records.description: 100% private, free online file converter. Convert PDF, DOCX, JPG, PNG, SVG, MP4, MP3, and WAV files instantly in your browser with zero server uploads.

records.name: Jev for Slack
records.tagline: Turn Slack messages into actions with AI classification
records.description: Jev classifies Slack messages using your team's criteria, then adds reactions, replies in threads or posts to the right channel. Build rules inside Slack with yes/no, single-choice or multiple-choice outcomes. Trigger them on new messages, edits or emoji reactions. Preview decisions and actions before enabling, then review activity. You control the channels, criteria and action text. No API key needed.

records.name: WhyNotReply
records.tagline: Find out why your resume gets no replies
records.description: Most resume checkers give you a vague percentage and generic tips. WhyNotReply reads your resume like a hiring manager and shows exactly what's holding it back. • Score out of 100, computed the same way every time • Every finding quotes the exact line it's about • Checks 15 issue types: missing metrics, duties instead of achievements, passive language, gaps • Shows your strengths, not just problems • Before/after rewrites (Premium) iPhone, PDF/DOCX/TXT, no sign-up.

records.name: Statable Analytics
records.tagline: Web analytics built for you and your AI agents
records.description: Statable is web analytics built for humans and AI agents. Use the simple dashboard yourself, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and other agents through MCP to read reports, analyze traffic, and configure tracking, goals, and funnels. No cookies, no analytics consent banner in most cases, and your data stays hosted in the EU.

records.name: PetPaw
records.tagline: Bring Your Pet to Your Desktop
records.description: Clone your pet into a desktop companion that stays with you through work, study, and life.

records.name: Inklura Sync
records.tagline: Keep WooCommerce and PrestaShop in sync
records.description: Updating a product shouldn’t mean updating two stores by hand. Inklura Sync keeps products, stock movements, order records and customer contacts in sync between one WooCommerce store and one PrestaShop store. Review incoming changes in audit mode before going live. Data moves directly between your stores, with automatic retries if delivery fails. French interface and support; guides in French and English. From €249/year excl. VAT.

records.name: Ouba
records.tagline: Interactive romance stories you read and steer
records.description: Ouba is interactive romance you read and steer. Every story is a serial with a premise and an ending. At each scene you pick one of the moves or type your own, and the next scene follows from it. Start reading free in your browser, no signup. The Android app is on Google Play, and on iPhone you read in the browser. Sign in to keep your stories. Credits are only for reading past the daily free turns.

records.name: Next Session
records.tagline: Coordinate campaigns, not calendars.
records.description: Next Session gets your tabletop gaming group to actually agree on a date. Propose a session, everyone votes, and it locks itself in — no group-chat scheduling chaos.

records.name: Lonkind
records.tagline: Lonkind: Connect and share with the world.
records.description: Connect with friends and family, anytime, anywhere.

records.name: imobi.app
records.tagline: Site and CRM designed for Brazilian real estate agents
records.description: Create your free real estate website and organize clients, properties, and deals with an easy-to-use CRM. Explore real brokers' websites. No credit card required

records.name: ListLeaf — Plan, Shop & Save
records.tagline: Meal planning and grocery lists built around your budget
records.description: ListLeaf brings meal planning, recipes, grocery lists, pantry tracking, and budgeting together in one simple app. Plan meals around your household and budget, turn ingredients into organized shopping lists, keep track of what you already have, and make grocery shopping easier without juggling multiple apps.

records.name: Milvago AI
records.tagline: Open-core - AI usage and Shadow AI control for Endpoint
records.description: Open-core AI usage control and shadow AI discovery: open source Community for the browser, commercial Enterprise modules for selected native AI apps.

records.name: KharchaBook
records.tagline: Private, offline expense tracking for Indian households
records.description: KharchaBook is a private, offline-first Android expense tracker for Indian households. Log groceries, milk, fuel, bills, medicines, and custom expenses in seconds. Review monthly and category reports, export PDF or Excel, create local backups, and protect everything with a PIN. No account, cloud sync, ads, or tracking. To install: first join the DinaLabs Google Group, open the tester opt-in link and choose “Become a tester,” then download KharchaBook from Google Play.

records.name: Deyaho
records.tagline: Artificial Intelligence Agents that manage your business.
records.description: White-label AI agents for resellers: launch them under your own brand and set your own prices. One agent answers WhatsApp, Telegram, web chat, email, Instagram, Messenger and phone calls from one knowledge base. It books appointments into Google Calendar with no double bookings and chases overdue payments, while the debtor pays the business directly. EU-hosted, with AI disclosure enforced on every channel per the EU AI Act. Spanish-first, priced in EUR, MXN and USD.

records.name: Code Visualiser
records.tagline: Watch your recursive code run, one call at a time
records.description: Paste any recursive JavaScript function and watch it run as a live call tree. You can step forward and back through every call, see arguments go down and return values come back up, and watch the call stack grow and shrink. Memoisation and variables are tracked as you go. Your code runs in a sandbox in your browser, and infinite loops are caught safely. Share a link to any trace or export it as an animation. Free, no sign-up

records.name: HireNova: AI Interview Prep
records.tagline: HireNova: AI Interview Prep
records.description: Hey everyone! 👋 I built HireNova to help people prepare for job interviews with: • AI mock interviews • CV / ATS analysis • Interview question generation • CV & job matching I'm looking for honest feedback from people who are currently job hunting or preparing for interviews. 🌐 https://hirenova-8ba18.web.app/ iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hirenova-ai-interview-prep/id6811734433 Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logan.hirenova

records.name: Guatopo QR Express
records.tagline: Fast, secure, ultra-lightweight & ad-free QR generator
records.description: Meet Guatopo QR Express – a premium, ultra-lightweight Android app built for maximum privacy and speed. Generate high-definition QR codes instantly for any link, text, or social media profile. No annoying ads, no battery drain, and no data tracking. Fully secure and optimized under the tech seal of Guatopo91 Studios. Support an independent developer today for just $0.99!

records.name: Storytime
records.tagline: Just talk, let Storytime create.
records.description: Hit record and just talk, or start from anything: a PDF, a website link, an article, a prompt. In seconds Storytime makes the final edit: stumbles cut, captions, visuals, music. Use your own uploads, stock or AI visuals, or go faceless.

records.name: SmartSell Quiz AI Boost
records.tagline: Build smarter quizzes. Recommend better products.
records.description: SmartSell Quiz AI Boost helps merchants create product recommendation quizzes that guide shoppers to the right products. Build a product quiz, shopping quiz, product finder, or personalized quiz with AI-powered recommendations and conditional logic. Capture leads and customer preferences, personalize quiz results, and collect data for marketing. Use analytics and A/B testing to optimize quiz performance and create better product discovery experiences across your store.

records.name: CryptoRisk Studio
records.tagline: See the risk in your crypto — read-only, free
records.description: CryptoRisk Studio shows how much risk is in your crypto portfolio: a 0–100 risk score where every point is explained, real crash replays (COVID, LUNA, FTX), liquidation distance for futures, a monthly-buy simulator and an AI analyst that only uses numbers the app calculated. It connects to Binance with a read-only key, or you type in your coins — it can never trade or withdraw. Runs on your computer (Windows & Mac); your keys never leave it.

records.name: Grateful
records.tagline: Write three good things. Notice more of them.
records.description: Grateful is a focused gratitude journal built around one small habit: write three good things every day. Use guided prompts when words don't come, tag how each moment felt, build a gentle streak, and revisit memories through your journal and calendar. There is no feed, no pressure, and no blank-page overwhelm—just two minutes to train your attention toward what's already good. Sign in with Apple or Google to keep entries backed up across devices.

records.name: MoveDay — Moving Day Planner
records.tagline: The all-in-one planner for a stress-free move
records.description: MoveDay is a lightweight planner for anyone with a move date on the calendar. It combines a checklist organized by weeks before the move (8 weeks out through move-in day), a budget tracker that shows budgeted vs. actually spent per category, and a live countdown to moving day — all in a clean interface that works right in your browser. No sign-up and nothing to install: your data saves locally, so you can pick up right where you left off.

records.name: Nivro
records.tagline: AI platform to write, design, schedule & publish content
records.description: Nivro automates the full content workflow for bloggers, creators & agencies. From one keyword: scrape live Google SERPs, analyze top competitors, generate SEO+GEO optimized articles in your brand voice, design Pinterest pins with a built-in Image Template Studio (no Canva needed), schedule Facebook posts, and auto-publish to WordPress with schema & images included. Bulk CSV import, multi-site support, one unified dashboard. 7-day free trial.

records.name: Fold
records.tagline: Send messages at the speed of a paper airplane
records.description: Every other messaging app races to deliver instantly. Fold does the opposite on purpose: you fold your note into a paper airplane and throw it across a real map, and it takes real-world time to arrive. The time is shaped by the actual distance between you and your friend, the plane you chose, and the live wind along its route. A message to someone across town might land in minutes. One to the other side of the planet can take days or weeks. You can open the map and watch it fly.

records.name: Syllabloom
records.tagline: Turn class materials into source-linked study cards
records.description: Add a syllabus, slides, or notes. Syllabloom organizes one class, extracts important dates, and creates source-linked study cards you can review, edit, study, and export to Anki. We're opening a free beta and want students to tell us where the cards are accurate, confusing, or simply not useful.

records.name: Quotethought – Quotes & Writing App
records.tagline: Because every thought is worth quoting.
records.description: QuoteThought is a creative platform for writers, poets, thinkers, and storytellers. Create beautiful quote cards, write poetry, articles, and stories, collaborate with other creators, and discover inspiring ideas. We built QuoteThought to give your thoughts more than a place in your notes app. We’re launching to connect with creative people, gather feedback, and grow the community together. Where Every Thought Becomes Worth Sharing.

records.name: nobrainer-tech-flow
records.tagline: From task to done: one AI workflow for your coding agent
records.description: Your agent says "Done." nobrainer-tech-flow shows what was delivered, the proof, what was not checked and what is left for you to decide. One open-source workflow for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and other coding agents, instead of 50+ separate tools. Set up with one message: the agent verifies the release, shows the planned changes with a rollback path, then installs. Free, MIT. Your client's own usage costs still apply.

records.name: SalaryDial
records.tagline: Australian take-home pay, one turn of the dial
records.description: SalaryDial is a free Australian pay calculator with a clean dial interface. Explore take-home pay, salary versus contracting, bonuses and equity scenarios. Adjust super, HELP and pay periods, compare offers and export a report. No sign-up; calculation inputs stay in your browser. Uses Australian FY 2026–27 assumptions. General information, not personal financial advice.

records.name: QRMaple
records.tagline: QR codes you can change after printing. Pay once.
records.description: QRMaple makes QR codes you can change after printing. Print one on a menu, flyer, or package, then change where it points any time without reprinting. Paid plans are a one-time purchase, not a subscription, with unlimited codes and scans. See which QR code gets scanned and when (by day, hour, and weekday), plus full design and bulk creation from CSV. A plain black-and-white QR generator is free with no sign-up.

records.name: Userflo
records.tagline: Turn customer feedback into repeat purchases
records.description: Userflo helps you collect feedback through beautiful, fully branded forms people actually enjoy filling. AI summarizes every response so you spot patterns in seconds — with every raw response one click away, so nuance never gets flattened. Built-in promotions let you show offers, ads, and new products to respondents when they're most engaged, turning feedback into repeat purchases.

records.name: Stagelab
records.tagline: AI check-ins and prep guidance for physique competitors
records.description: StageLab helps physique athletes prepare for the stage with more clarity. Upload progress photos for AI-powered physique feedback, review posing analysis, and keep your weekly check-ins, prep plan, and peak week guidance in one place. Built for competitors and coaches across bodybuilding, Classic Physique, Men’s Physique, Bikini, Wellness, and Figure.

records.name: Leona
records.tagline: Leona Career Toolkit
records.description: Leona is an AI-powered career toolkit for building CVs, cover letters, and portfolios, tracking job applications, and practicing interviews.

records.name: Mood Based Meal Planner
records.tagline: Pick your mood, get a recipe, build a shopping list"
records.description: Most meal planners ignore how you feel. This one asks first: pick a mood (stressed, sluggish, sad, happy, anxious, unfocused) and get a matched recipe with a "why this fits" note, then build a shopping list in one click. No login needed to try it. Free tier included — $12 one-time (no subscription) unlocks all 6 moods, the full recipe catalog, and free-text mood input instead of picking from a list.

records.name: Pivot
records.tagline: data analysis tool
records.description: Pivot is AI-powered desktop software for data cleaning and analysis. Clean messy CSV and Excel files, run statistical tests, build charts and regression models, and ask questions in plain English. Your data stays on your machine.

records.name: MyShiftCalc
records.tagline: Free calculators for work hours, overtime, and payroll math
records.description: Free suite of payroll tools: Time Card Calculator, Business Days Counter, and Decimal Time Converter. Auto-saves your data. Privacy-focused and free.

records.name: Topping
records.tagline: One prompt to a finished Short you can actually edit
records.description: Topping turns one prompt into a finished vertical video: scenes, AI voiceover, captions and music. Unlike one-shot AI video tools, it all lands on a real timeline, so you can swap the voice, restyle captions, change the music or redo a single scene.

records.name: starkovs.dev · PennyHub
records.tagline: Family budget tracker for Canada & USA - no bank needed
records.description: PennyHub helps couples and families track shared expenses together. No bank connections required - just open the app, add what you spent, and see the full picture in real time. Built for Canada & USA with CAD/USD support, AI receipt scanning, savings goals, and family sharing. Free to download on the App Store.

records.name: MQTT Logger
records.tagline: TLS + auth, multi-topic subscribe, auto-JSON flattening
records.description: Stop wrestling with MQTT Explorer's UI. Connect to any broker (Mosquitto, HiveMQ, EMQX, AWS IoT, ThingsBoard), subscribe to multiple topics with wildcards, watch JSON payloads auto-flatten into clean CSV columns — and publish test messages without leaving the tool. Built by an industrial IoT engineer who has actually debugged broker auth issues at 3am.

records.name: Munch Menu
records.tagline: Smart qr code menu for restaurant and cafes
records.description: Munch Menu is a QR ordering system and digital menu for restaurants in India. Guests scan a table QR, browse the menu, and order from their phone — while restaurants manage live orders, kitchen status, AI menu images, AI order insights, and sales analytics from one dashboard.

records.name: J10M: lancement !
records.tagline: Des mini-jeux éducatifs en ligne gratuits
records.description: Plus de 50 jeux gratuits, tous faits maison, jouables dans le navigateur sans compte ni installation. Le serveur rejoue chaque partie avant d'accepter un score : les classements sont honnêtes. La page s'ouvre tout de suite, le jeu ne se charge qu'au clic. À côté des classiques (FreeCell, Spider, échecs, 2048), des jeux de cartes rares en ligne : belote, coinche, tarot, manille, couyon. Logique, réflexes, quiz : pensé en français d'abord.

records.name: VPNLY
records.tagline: Free VPN for browser and apps — no sign-up required
records.description: VPNLY is a completely free VPN that provides you with reliable protection and anonymity online. No registration and no limits on traffic and speed.

records.name: KissMySkills MCP
records.tagline: 2000+ expert AI skills inside Claude & ChatGPT via MCP
records.description: KissMySkills is now an MCP connector. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client, and your AI gets on-demand access to 2,000+ expert skills and prompts: SEO strategist, recruiter, Shopify developer, copywriter and more. Just say "load the SEO specialist" and it finds the right skill and starts working in that role, right in your chat. No files to download, no copy-paste. One subscription, the whole library, new skills added regularly.

records.name: YourDoc
records.tagline: One app for doctors' schedules and patients' records
records.description: YourDoc gives doctors a professional profile with a personal QR code, online booking with automatic reminders, and one dashboard for every patient's history, prescriptions and reports. Write e-prescriptions by typing or with a stylus, track practice statistics, and keep walk-in and phone bookings working as before. Patients can find a nearby doctor, book in a few taps, keep their family's health records secure, and get reminders so they never miss a visit.

records.name: Elokin
records.tagline: Private, local-first voice dictation for Mac
records.description: Elokin turns your voice into ready-to-use text directly on your Mac. Use local speech recognition, writing profiles, custom vocabulary, and optional AI providers—with no account or subscription.

records.name: MODOU APP
records.tagline: Speak your language, Modou translate instantly
records.description: Modou AI instantly translates your voice messages and texts right inside WhatsApp, Telegram and Messenger. 100+ languages, including Wolof, Pulaar and Yoruba.

records.name: Kanelbulle
records.tagline: A cookie banner, but for cinnamon buns
records.description: Kanelbulle is a spoof cookie banner for Kanelbullens dag, Sweden's Cinnamon Bun Day on October 4th. Add one script tag and your visitors meet "Our cinnamon bun policy", with links to the nearest bakery and a recipe. Optional countdown in the days before, Swedish or English based on your site, light and dark mode, seven placements. About 3 KB, no cookies, no tracking, no dependencies. Free and open source.

records.name: Data2AIBot
records.tagline: Build one AI agent for Instagram, WhatsApp & web
records.description: Data2AIBot turns your business knowledge into one AI agent that works across Instagram, WhatsApp Business, and website chat. No need to build and manage separate bots for every channel. Automate repetitive questions, reply faster, and hand conversations to a human when needed. Sensitive customer data such as names, emails, phone numbers, and addresses is masked before AI processing for more privacy-conscious automation.

records.name: OptiMax Arena AI Simulation Builder
records.tagline: Turn project evidence into verified Arena models
records.description: Turn Word, PDF, image, and spreadsheet requirements into Arena simulation models. The Windows app detects Arena 16.2+, quotes before generation, builds through COM, runs validation, and verifies the saved model.

records.name: DailyTrace 2.0
records.tagline: Your calendar, beside your time records
records.description: DailyTrace 2.0 puts your calendar beside your records. Selected events show on Home: use one to prefill a past record, or start timing from it. DailyTrace never classifies events or changes your calendar. Also new: Undo resumes a timer you stopped by mistake, tap a timeline gap over 30 minutes to add a past record, redesigned weekly, monthly and yearly share posters, and Japanese on iPhone, widgets and Apple Watch. Records stay on your device. No account.

records.name: RepoGauntlet
records.tagline: Give coding benchmarks an executable quality check
records.description: Check whether a task rejects broken and incomplete candidates while accepting the reference fix. Broken baseline. Plausible shortcut. Reference fix. The web workbench replays committed reports. It does not run untrusted candidate code in the browser.

records.name: ATLAS 1
records.tagline: #1 Techwear & Cyberpunk Fashion Store | Worldwide Shipping
records.description: ATLAS 1 is a curated fashion universe for techwear, cyberpunk, and tactical streetwear. Explore 25+ complete looks across SYSTEM (dark, functional, dystopian) and ASCENSION (experimental, avant-garde). With hundreds of modular pieces and personalized style guidance via ATLAS Coach, we make futuristic style effortless. Worldwide shipping available.

records.name: SellForge
records.tagline: Your online store, professionally managed.
records.description: Most small businesses that want to sell online don't want a second job managing a website. They want product photos up, orders coming in, and customers being looked after — not hosting renewals, SSL certificates, or plugin updates. SellForge is Plan9 Studios' managed ecommerce platform, built for exactly that. It's a complete, ready-made online store — branded with your logo, colours and identity from day one — with hosting and SSL included and fully configured on your behalf.

records.name: Syntro Health
records.tagline: Clinical Precision Nutrition & Biochemical MNT Engine
records.description: Syntro Health is an AI-powered clinical nutrition engine engineered on Harvard Healthy Eating Plate, Shils Modern Nutrition MNT, and ICMR-NIN protocols. Features 3D interactive Apple-style cellular plate visualization, 25+ pharmacology drug-nutrient interaction safeguards, and laboratory biomarker-driven precision meal planning.

records.name: Quest.Dog Fresh walk ideas for your dog
records.tagline: Turn every dog walk into a new adventure
records.description: Most dog apps track distance or teach commands at home. Quest.Dog is about variety: a fog-of-war map clears as you walk, showing where you and your dog have never been. Real places nearby come with small quests (paws in a fountain, recall on a busy square) across 7 families like Water, City and Weather, so your dog gets a balanced life, not the same loop. Premium plans loops through unexplored areas. Built solo in Switzerland with my dog Jaina. Live on iPhone in 19 countries.

records.name: FilePolish
records.tagline: Convert, compress and clean files on your own computer
records.description: FilePolish is a local-first file workshop for Windows. Convert HEIC photos, compress images or PDFs to a target size, clean photo metadata, and handle image batches. It shows measured output details and protects originals by default. Single-file tools are free; batch work and some PDF editing are paid. I’m looking for candid feedback on whether a newcomer can choose a tool and finish a job without guessing.

records.name: jev-bench
records.tagline: Open-source Jev benchmark: tested against frontier LLMs
records.description: An independent, reproducible benchmark of TypeSafe's Jev against openai/gpt-6-luna (cheap LLM) and openai/gpt-6-astra (frontier LLM). Tests accuracy, calibration, latency, and cost. All code is open source — run it yourself and verify the results.

records.name: Name of the launch
records.tagline: A fully managed AI Customer Agent for your business
records.description: AI Customer Hub provides fully managed AI Customer Agents for websites and WhatsApp. It helps businesses answer customer questions 24/7, recommend products, collect leads, support multiple languages, and hand conversations over to humans when needed. Unlike self-service chatbot tools, we handle the setup, business knowledge, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance for the customer.

records.name: Wrytely
records.tagline: Turn typed text and solved Math into your handwriting
records.description: Wrytely turns typed drafts, homework assignments, class notes, study materials, and supplied solved Math into pages written in your own handwriting. Start with a ready-made style or create a reusable style from your writing, choose paper, ink, spacing, and layout, then export as PNG or PDF.

records.name: Headrails
records.tagline: Slack for your team's AI agents
records.description: Everyone on your team uses an AI agent, but the handoffs between them are still manual. With Headrails, agents leave work for each other by role, pick it up in their next session, and reply as they go. What they learn goes into a shared memory your team can ask anytime.

records.name: Card Timeline+
records.tagline: See every Trello card’s workflow journey at a glance
records.description: Track how cards move through Trello. See the current stage, time in list, workflow path, move count, and chronological history in one Trello-native view. Add card badges, spot stuck work, and export timelines through Board Export+.

records.name: Nowly
records.tagline: Share what you do.
records.description: Nowly automatically shows what you are doing online in your Discord Rich Presence status. With a browser extension, it detects what you watch, listen to, or browse, and shares it in real time with your Discord friends: title, channel, progress, and clickable buttons.

records.name: Botly AI
records.tagline: Grow your business with an AI chatbot that never sleeps
records.description: Botly reads your website, learns your business and answers every visitor 24/7 in their own language. Add one line of code or install the WordPress plugin and it's live in minutes. For WooCommerce stores, Order Desk lets customers track orders, resend downloads, get invoices and raise support or refund requests on their own. Also: WhatsApp, multiple AI providers, custom styling and a free plan. Already live on DealMirror and Hostverge.
